project.name: CodeHub
project.executiveSummary: Codehub is a next-generation educational platform designed to democratize programming education in Pakistan and beyond. By combining gamified learning paths, Agentic AI tutoring in native languages (Urdu/English), and robust industry-standard compilation, CodeHub solves the engagement crisis in CS education. We don't just teach syntax; we turn C++, Python, and JavaScript learning into an immersive adventure.

problemStatement.description: Despite the booming demand for software engineers, students face significant barriers

barriers.title: Engagement Gap
barriers.description: Traditional coding platforms are dry, text-heavy, and lack motivation.

barriers.title: Generic AI Help
barriers.description: Standard chatbots give answers that are often too advanced or disconnected from the student's current syllabus.

barriers.title: Language Barrier
barriers.description: Most high-quality resources explain complex logic in high-level English, leaving non-native speakers (e.g., Urdu speakers) behind.

barriers.title: Theoretical Disconnect
barriers.description: Platforms often focus purely on syntax, ignoring the conceptual and theoretical foundations (MCQs).

barriers.title: Lack of Assessment Integrity
barriers.description: Remote learning lacks reliable proctoring, making it hard to verify student readiness.

solution.name: CodeHub
solution.description: CodeHub transforms the learning lifecycle into a Game Loop: Learn → Practice → Compete → Reward.

coreFeatures.name: RAG Based MCQ Generation
coreFeatures.description: An intelligent scraper gathers real-time data from the web, allowing the LLM to create fresh, theoretically sound multiple-choice questions on the fly.

coreFeatures.name: Agentic AI Tutors
coreFeatures.description: Unlike standard platforms, our AI agent doesn't just print text.

capabilities.description: The AI explains concepts and code reviews in Urdu and English.

components.value: Support for C++, Python, and JavaScript
Integrated Judge0 API for rapid, sandboxed, and secure code execution and testing
Algo-style problems with hidden test cases
Conceptual questions to ensure students understand the theory behind the code, not just the syntax
Earn currency to buy 'Hints' or unlock visual themes
Browser-based computer vision (MediaPipe) monitors user presence during exams
Detects tab switching or external help (Copy/Paste tracking)

components.description: Flexible schema for storing user progress & game states
Generates hints and translates explanations to Urdu

steps.name: Onboarding
steps.description: User selects a language track (e.g., Python) and an instruction language (Urdu).

steps.name: The Lesson
steps.description: User enters the 'Minecraft' world. They face a theoretical MCQ about Classes.

steps.name: The Challenge
steps.description: User is asked to write a class for a 'Creeper'.

steps.name: The Agent Intervention
steps.description: The AI Agent speaks: 'Apne semicolon miss kiya hai line 4 par' (You missed a semicolon on line 4).

steps.name: The Success
steps.description: Code compiles via Judge0. User earns Coins and unlocks the next level.

steps.name: The Exam
steps.description: User enters 'Exam Mode.' Webcam activates for proctoring. Tab switching is disabled.

project.conclusion: CodeHub is not just another coding site. It is a cultural bridge and a gamified ecosystem. By leveraging Agentic AI to speak the student's language, we are building the most accessible coding platform in South Asia.
